result.topic_en: General differential formulas giving the partial derivatives of a planet's geocentric longitude and latitude with respect to its orbital elements (radius vector, argument of latitude, inclination, node, mean anomaly, eccentricity angle).
result.transcription:
Allgemeine Differentialformeln
für die geocentrischen Oerter des Planeten
$l$ geocentrische Länge des Planeten $l - \Omega = \eta$
$L$ heliocentrische Länge der Erde
$u$ Argument der Breite
$b$ geocentrische Breite

1. $a \tang\varphi \sin v = \alpha = \frac{\partial r}{\partial M}$
2. $-a\cos\varphi\cos v = \alpha' = \frac{\partial r}{\partial\varphi}$
3. $\frac{aa\cos\varphi}{rr} = \mathfrak{G} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial M}$
4. $\frac{aa\sin E}{rr}(2-ee-e\cos E) = \mathfrak{G}' = \frac{\partial v}{\partial\varphi}$
5. $\frac{\tang\eta}{\cos i} = \tang M$
6. $\sin\eta\tang i = \tang N$ $\cos N = \frac{\cos M}{\cos\eta}$, $\sin N = \sin M\sin i$
7. $\frac{\tang(M-u)}{\cos\eta\cos i} = \tang P$ [$-\sin$][?]
8. $\frac{R}{\Delta'}\sin(L-l) = x$
9. $\frac{x}{r} = A = \frac{\partial l}{\partial r}$
10. $-x\cotang(M-u) = B = \frac{\partial l}{\partial u}$
11. $-\cos\eta\tang b = C = \frac{\partial l}{\partial i}$
12. $\frac{R}{\Delta'}\cos(L-l) = y$
13. $1+y = D = \frac{\partial l}{\partial\Omega}$
14. $\frac{-y\sin b\cos b}{r} = A' = \frac{\partial b}{\partial r}$
15 $\frac{r}{\Delta}\cdot\frac{\sin(M-u)\cos(N-b-P)}{\sin P} = B' = \frac{\partial b}{\partial u}$
16. $\frac{r\sin u\cos i\cos(N-b)}{\Delta\cos N} = C' = \frac{\partial b}{\partial i}$
17. $x\sin b\cos b = D' = \frac{\partial b}{\partial\Omega}$
18 $A\alpha + B\mathfrak{G} = E$
19. $A'\alpha + B'\mathfrak{G} = E'$
20. $A\alpha' + B\mathfrak{G}' = F$
21. $A'\alpha' + B'\mathfrak{G}' = F'$
